ambientMotion.formula: pulse = 0.5 + 0.5*sin(time*0.55), period 11.42 s. Glow circle r = 190 + pulse*24 = 190..214 px (201.4 at the hold) and its opacity = 0.7 + pulse*0.3 = 0.70..1.00. The halo, disc and ring are static. The wide r 980 wash at opacity 0.13 is static.

wx = ((sp*4*time + i*560) mod 2400) - 240 ; edge = min((wx+240)/210, (2160-wx)/210, 1) ; vertical bob = 6*sin(0.4*time + i*1.7) (+-6 px, period 15.71 s) ; group opacity = 0.92*0.96*clamp01(edge). Lane speeds sp*4: #0 40 px/s (wrap 60.0 s), #1 28 px/s (85.7 s), #2 48 px/s (50.0 s), #3 22 px/s (109.1 s), #4 16.8 px/s (142.9 s). A wrapped cloud re-enters at x -240 and fades up over its first 210 px; it fades back out over the last 210 px before x 2160. Unlike scene 01 the fade-out IS on screen for the slow low cloud (#4 is at edge 0.30 at the hold and at 0.04 a few seconds later).

ambientMotion.what: Birds drift right, bob and flap
ambientMotion.formula: x = ((rx*2300 + time*(14 + rs*10)) mod 2580) - 140 ; y = 210 + ry*190 + 9*sin(0.7*time + 2.2*i) (+-9 px, period 8.98 s) ; wing arc control y = -3.2 - 3.4*sin(7*time + 1.9*i) (period 0.90 s) ; scale 0.85 + rs*0.5. Measured per bird: #0 speed 18.12 px/s, scale 1.056, mid y 230.7, loop 142.4 s ; #1 speed 16.85 px/s, scale 0.993, mid y 275.5, loop 153.1 s ; #2 speed 20.27 px/s, scale 1.163, mid y 335.6, loop 127.3 s. All three are on screen through the whole 18 s hold.
circle opacity = 0.2 + 0.8*(0.5 + 0.5*sin(pi*time)) = 0.2..1.0, period 2 s (0.376 at the hold), multiplied by the tower group opacity 0.97.
blade transform = rotate((time*46) mod 360) about (238, 879). One full turn every 7.83 s, constant speed - the only element in the scene that rotates all the way round.
group transform = rotate(sin(time*1.7)*7 deg) about (650, 937) - +-7 degrees, period 3.70 s (-2.95 deg at the hold). The sock itself does not change shape.

ambientMotion.what: Mini trucks drive, spin their wheels and bob
ambientMotion.formula: d = (time*speed + phase) mod 2560 ; tx = (dir 1) d - 300, (dir -1) 2220 - d ; wheel spin = ((time*speed)/37.7)*360 mod 360 (37.7 = the r 6 wheel's circumference, so the wheels roll true) ; body bob = sin(time*6 + i*2.1)*0.5 (+-0.5 px, period 1.05 s; the shadow and the wheels do not bob). Lane 0: 54 px/s, one crossing every 47.4 s. Lane 1: 70 px/s, 36.6 s. Lane 2: 62 px/s, 41.3 s.

shk = clamp01(1 - (968 - y)/260) ; the ellipse is drawn only while shk > 0.02 (i.e. until the jet is 255 px above the runway), at cy 980, rx 72*(0.55 + 0.45*shk), ry 5.5, fill alpha 0.2*shk. So the shadow shrinks and fades as the jet climbs and vanishes about 2 s into the climb-out.

Diffing network(174) against network(275) (3.37 s later) changes 170 attributes, and they are all in: the sun glow (r + opacity), the 5 cloud transforms (and cloud #4's opacity while it fades), the 3 bird transforms and wing paths, the tower beacon opacity, the control-tower beacon opacity, the radar blade transform, the windsock transform, the 3 mini-truck transforms and their 9 wheel transforms, the jet (whole sub-tree), and the invisible coverage map's route dash offsets and pin pulses. Mt Fuji, every one of the 25 buildings, the haze, the airport ground, the office, the road and the sky never move. The CityBuilding component is memoised (line 593), so the back and front tiers are literally the same node objects every frame.

ambientMotion.what: Player camera drift on narrow viewports only (outside the scene function)
ambientMotion.formula: Desktop: a static crop centred on stage x 1250. As the visible window narrows (mobT = clamp((1500 - boxW/scale)/880)), the crop blends toward CAM_M[4]: centre x 1300 -> 1240, y 600 -> 610, zoom 1.02 -> 1.04 across the 18 s dwell with ease-in-out, exponentially smoothed (rate 2.6/s). Reduced motion: fixed at the midpoint. This is the gentlest camera of the five stops - the finale is meant to be looked at whole.

choreography.frames: 80 (the first frame of scene 05, = scene 04's held picture)
choreography.what: recede = 0, so the ENTIRE daylight world group is at opacity 0: no sky halo on the ground, no sun, no Fuji, no city, no road. What is on screen is the sky gradient, the big sky halo ellipse (which lives outside the recede group), the coverage map at full opacity, and the empty KPI wrapper div. Every piece of the finale is already in the DOM at this point, fully built, just invisible.

Nothing changes but the ambient loops (the clouds, birds, trucks and jet are all already running at time = frame/30, invisible). titleEnter has already decayed to 0 at frame 104's formula - but SceneTitle draws nothing anyway.

recede = easeInOutCubic over 26 frames (0.87 s at the player's 36 frames/s). The world group's opacity IS recede, so the whole daylight city fades up as one flat cross-dissolve: 86 -> 0.000, 90 -> 0.015, 95 -> 0.166, 99 -> 0.500, 104 -> 0.883, 108 -> 0.985, 112 -> 1.000. At the same time the map div fades out (opacity = mapIn*(1-recede)) and pulls back and left: scale (0.95 + 0.05*mapIn)*(1 - recede*0.08) goes 1.00 -> 0.92 and translate goes 0 -> -36 px in x. There is no camera move, no parallax, no staggering: one group of 558 nodes goes from invisible to visible together. This is the single beat the redraw has the most room to improve.

logoEnter (spring from frame 96), flash (96->126), taglineK (116->140) and statsK (128->174) are all computed, but the whole block they drive is gated on !window.JX_CLEAN_HERO, so NOTHING is drawn. In the site build these 78 frames of the finale are empty of any new event.

recede passes 0.96, so the KPI card wrapper div (already empty) is replaced by null and the root div drops from 5 children to 4. Positional-patcher gotcha for the redraw: the vignette div moves up one slot in the child list at this frame, so the patcher rewrites its style rather than keeping it.
The picture is complete and settled; only the ambient loops run. 62 frames (1.7 s at the entrance rate) of pure hold before the player even reaches its idle.

choreography.frames: 174 and onwards (the hold - 15.4 s of the 18 s stop, and for ever if the page is left open)
choreography.what: hero-glue.js STOPS[4].idle renders network(idleClk) with idleClk advancing as a FRAME clock, so ambient time = idleClk/30 keeps running: 5.80 s at frame 174, 21.19 s at the end of the dwell. Every choreography scalar is clamped, so nothing enters or leaves; the scene is carried entirely by the jet's 19 s cycle, the three road trucks, the five clouds, the three birds, the radar, the windsock and the four blinking lights.

choreography.frames: AirportPlane cycle - phase 1, approach (cycle t 0.00-5.10 s)
choreography.what: Constant ground speed: x = -282 + 120t, so the jet enters the frame (nose at x 0) at about t 1.58 s and is fully in frame by t 2.4 s. It descends on a flattening curve y = 968 - 165*(1-k)^1.35 with a gentle float sin(t*2.1)*3.2*(1-k), k = t/5.1: (t 0) x -282 y 803 ; (t 1) -162, 847 ; (t 2) -42, 882 ; (t 3) 78, 918 ; (t 4) 198, 948 ; (t 5) 318, 967. Pitch: a nose-up glide attitude of 6.4 deg with a +-1.1 deg wander, easing (smoothstep 0.55->0.92 of k, i.e. t 2.8-4.7 s) into a -2.6 deg flare. It passes IN FRONT of the control tower and the terminal, because the jet is the last thing painted.

choreography.frames: AirportPlane cycle - phase 2, rollout (cycle t 5.10-7.50 s)
choreography.what: Touchdown at x 330 at the same 120 px/s, then braking: x = 330 + 120*t2 - 25*t2^2 (t2 = t - 5.1), reaching 0 speed exactly at t2 2.4. Suspension bump y = 968 + 2.6*exp(-((t2-0.22)/0.16)^2) - a single 2.6 px squat 0.22 s after touchdown. Nose settles with a damped wobble rot = -2.6*exp(-1.9*t2)*cos(2.6*t2). For the first 1.05 s three tyre puffs trail behind the mains: circles at cx = x - 4 - 15*pi - 34*qq, cy = 965 - 9*qq, r = 2.5 + 8*qq, group opacity (1-q)*0.55. Positions: (t 5.5) x 374 ; (t 6.0) 418 ; (t 6.5) 449 ; (t 7.0) 468 ; (t 7.5) 474.

choreography.frames: AirportPlane cycle - phase 3, hold at the stand (cycle t 7.50-9.10 s)
choreography.what: x 474, y 968, rot 0 for 1.6 s. The jet sits still on the runway just right of the terminal; only its fin beacon blinks. (It never taxis to the apron - the stand markings at x 118-358 are never used.)

choreography.frames: AirportPlane cycle - phase 4, takeoff roll (cycle t 9.10-11.30 s)
choreography.what: Accelerating from standstill: x = 474 + 30*t3^2 (t3 = t - 9.1), so 478.8 at t 9.5, 498 at t 10.0, 533 at t 10.5, 582 at t 11.0, 619 at t 11.3. Still at y 968. Rotation comes late: rot = -4*smoothstep(1.5, 2.2, t3), i.e. the nose only lifts over the last 0.7 s of the roll, reaching -4 deg at liftoff.

choreography.frames: AirportPlane cycle - phase 5, climb-out (cycle t 11.30-16.70 s)
choreography.what: Accelerating away: x = 619 + 132*t4 + 32*t4^2 (t4 = t - 11.3). y = 968 - (x-619)*0.5*smoothstep(0, 1.15, t4), which blends off the runway onto a geometrically straight diagonal of slope -0.5 (about 26.6 deg). Pitch settles at the path angle: rot = -4 - 23.5*smoothstep(0.04, 1.2, t4) -> -27.5 deg. Gear retracts over t4 0.3-1.4 (gear = 1 - smoothstep, and the gear group's own opacity is clamp01(gear*1.5 - 0.25), so the legs are gone by t4 about 1.2). Track: (t 12.0) x 727 y 932 ; (t 12.5) 824, 866 ; (t 13.0) 936, 810 ; (t 13.5) 1064, 745 ; (t 14.0) 1209, 673 ; (t 14.5) 1369, 593 ; (t 15.0) 1546, 505 ; (t 15.5) 1738, 409 ; (t 16.0) 1946, 304 (leaving the frame). It crosses IN FRONT of the Tokyo Tower's mast around t 14.0-14.6 and exits top right under the sun. The ground shadow has faded out by about t 12.3.

choreography.frames: AirportPlane cycle - phase 6, gap (cycle t 16.70-19.00 s)
choreography.what: AirportPlane returns null: the whole 41-node sub-tree is removed and the sky is empty of aircraft for 2.3 s, then the next approach starts. Over the 18 s dwell the visitor sees most of one full cycle; the cycle is not locked to the scene, so which phase is on screen at any moment of the hold depends only on ambient time (at the hold's first frame, t 5.80 s, the jet is braking on the runway at x 402).

AirportPlane's node list changes shape between phases - the shadow ellipse is conditional (shk > 0.02) and the puff group is present only in the first 1.05 s of the rollout - so the group's children shift position and the diff patcher replaces nodes rather than patching attributes (26 tag replacements between two hold frames). Keep the node list stable (render the shadow and puffs at opacity 0 instead of null) if the redraw keeps this patcher.

disabledOrHidden: SceneTitle ('04 / NETWORK', heading '1都6県、そして新潟市へ届ける。'): returns null because hero-flag.js sets window.JX_CLEAN_HERO = true (hero-port-b.js line 997, called at 1894). Not even a wrapper div remains. titleEnter is computed at line 1683 and used nowhere visible.

The entire logo / tagline / eyebrow block: LogoReveal, the 76 px tagline '大切な荷物を、きょうも確実に。' and the 17 px eyebrow 'RELIABLE DELIVERY, ACROSS EVERY REGION' are gated on 'frame >= 94 && !window.JX_CLEAN_HERO' (line 1895), so the whole centre column of the finale is absent. logoEnter, flash and taglineK are computed and unused. The site shows its own HTML copy instead.

Both KpiCards ('主要拠点 / OUR BASES' listing 板橋 / 志木 / 入間, and 'ネットワーク概況 / NETWORK OVERVIEW' with the 3 / 7 / 32台 stats): KpiCard returns null under the flag (line 865), so lines 1866-1892 build nothing. Their wrapper div survives, empty, until frame 106 and is dropped at frame 107.

The coverage map (CoverageMap, 105 nodes: the grey land mask, the 7 covered prefectures with their heat fills, the route lines, the label plates and the pulsing hub pin): the div is STILL IN THE TREE at the hold with opacity mapIn*(1-recede) = 0, and its flow animation keeps running every frame. It is the single biggest piece of invisible work in the finale. Lines 1862-1864.
FloatingParticles('network', 28 motes): the function's first statement is 'return null' (line 675), so line 1735 draws nothing.

The 30 'n-star' circles (line 1733) and the 26 'n2-star' circles (line 1758) are all drawn with opacity 0 - 56 invisible nodes, left over from a night sky. Their twinkle values tw are computed and discarded.
The shooting star (lines 1760-1767): guarded by 'if (true) return null', so it never draws.
The sun's rays: the IIFE at lines 1742-1750 builds a 12-ray path string and returns null. The finale's sun has no rays, exactly like scene 01's.
The empty <g opacity='0.5 - recede*0.3'> at lines 1725-1728: a group whose two children were deleted. It renders as an empty <g opacity='0.2'> in the DOM.

Mt Fuji's right half: everything from x 854 to x 1177 is behind CITY_DEEP#6/#7/#8 and CITY_BACK#2/#3, and the toe at x 1177-1206 is under 0.6-alpha haze. Do not expect the right slope in a screenshot - only three slivers (x 739-772, 777-819, 850-854) and the left half survive.

CITY_DEEP#4's right half (x 604-652) is completely behind CITY_BACK#1; CITY_DEEP#5 shows only x 738-776 between y 733 and 828; CITY_DEEP#7 is cut by CITY_BACK#2 below y 718 and by CITY_BACK#3 below y 618; CITY_DEEP#12 shows only above y 638; CITY_DEEP#14 only above y 768. CITY_DEEP#0 is clipped by CITY_BACK#0 from x 116.
CITY_FRONT#0's bottom-left corner (x 678-714, below y 948) is covered by the airport apron, which is painted after it.

CITY_DEEP#14's last 2 px (x 1920-1922) and the sun's glow, the sky halo and the ground halo all extend past the frame; cloud #4 is off-screen right at the hold (x 2097-2247) and re-enters from the left about 7 s later.
The airport stand block and its three stripes (x 118-358, y 950-966) are drawn as parking markings but the jet never taxis there - it lands, brakes, holds on the runway at x 474 and takes off again.

Lamp light / glows: none anywhere. The DAY palette is 'lamps off'. The only lit things are four small blinking lamps (Tokyo Tower tip, control-tower beacon, jet fin beacon, 12 amber runway edge lights at a fixed 0.9), the warm windows of CITY_BACK/CITY_FRONT, and the mini trucks' 3.5 px headlights.

No utility poles, no streetlights, no fence, no pavement tactile strip, no vending machines - none of scene 01's street furniture exists here. The whole ground plane is: apron, runway, office, kerb, road, three trucks.

The scene has no text of any kind once the flag is on: the office's sign plate is a blank white rectangle with a vermilion tab, and the mini trucks' lettering is two abstract bars. Nothing in the finale says 'Sanpou' or '三豊運輸'.

SVG id collision risk: haloSoft, sunGlow and horizHaze are NOT per-scene ids (compare GlowDef/HazeDef's id parameter in scenes 01-03). During the 04 -> 05 dissolve two copies of this scene can coexist, and hero-glue.js has to move the incoming stage first in the document (lines 232-234) so its url(#...) references resolve to its own defs.
